versions.content: Th e NvM module shall not store the currently used Dataset index automatically in a persistent way. Software components shall check the specific error/status of all blocks they are responsible for by using NvM_GetErrorStatus [ SWS_NvM_00015 ] with specific block IDs to determine the validity of the corresponding RAM blocks.
